body_text: BVNK holds 40+ licences and registrations across the UK (for fiat), EU and US for fiat and digital asset payments- including an EMI in the UK (FCA-regulated) and Malta, CASP registrations in Europe, and Money Transmitter Licenses across the US. We're not a bank, and crypto isn't FCA-regulated in the
BVNK works with businesses and financial institutions looking to process at least $500,000 in payments a month, with a minimum of 6 months of trading/operating history.
We're ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II certified, and independently audited against the highest standards for security and data management. See our full controls and credentials.

BVNK gives you six core capabilities from a single integration: Send (global payouts), Receive (payment acceptance), Store (unified fiat and stablecoin accounts), Convert (real-time FX between fiat and stablecoins), Spend (card issuing against stablecoin balances), and Earn (rewards on idle balances
